settings.name: group9_common_bo3_v1
settings.reference_policy: Choose maxCount indices uniformly without replacement, in prefix order, or in suffix order.
settings.deck_policy: Both players return the official 60 sample card IDs in the same order.
settings.match_rule: At most three games; stop at two wins. At the cap, more game wins takes the match; equal wins is a draw.
settings.match_score: Win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0. Aggregate is the unweighted mean of the three opponent score rates.
settings.seed_schedule: seed_base + 3*match_index + game_index; zero based; identical for each opponent.
settings.process_policy: One fresh Python process per reference; agent module persists within that process across matches.
settings.callback_policy: No __file__ in entry namespace; package working directory and sys.path; one or two callback arguments.
settings.randomness: Seed Python random at each game; reference uses a separate random.Random. Native and framework RNG control is unverified.
settings.hardware: Linux x86_64 CPU; CUDA hidden; numerical library thread limits set to one.
settings.eligibility: All 120 matches complete, no invalid responses or engine errors, and all three worker processes succeed.
